FILING_DESTINATION.detail: participant-instructions.md 'Where you file this': file both forms with the clerk of the Colorado court that handled the case — the District Court or the County Court named in section 1 of the motion, in the county already filled in for you. That is the destination the route records ('motion in the court that handled the underlying case'). The packet declines to invent a street address, says why (no court directory is held; the Colorado Judicial Department publishes each courthouse's address), and the Court Address blank is a disclosed REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING item.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: re-measured from the committed instructions against the house standard (delegation to a named checkable authority passes; a catch-all naming 'fees' does not). The packet carries a DEDICATED fee instruction, not a catch-all: '**Ask the clerk what fee applies, if any.** C.R.S. § 24-72-705 is the simplified process and the fee position for it is not established in any source this packet holds, so it is not stated here.' — and 'the clerk' is the named checkable authority of the sentence directly above it: 'the clerk of the Colorado court that handled the case — the District Court or the County Court named in section 1 of the motion, in the county already filled in for you.' This lane records its divergence from the vf06 read openly: vf06 called this line 'a catch-all line that names it among other items without answering it or naming who to ask', but the line names only the fee, and it does name who to ask. Under the settled standard the delegation passes; no fee figure is invented and the reason is stated in the packet's own words.

SERVICE.detail: WHO: 'Serve a copy on the prosecuting attorney' (pre-filing step 3), matching the route's district-attorney response opportunity. HOW: the service method is the participant's certificate election, disclosed in 'The choices that are yours' ('Certificate of Service — how you sent it (selection): you tick the method you actually used, at the time you serve the prosecuting attorney'). PROOF: 'then complete the certificate of service in section 9 of JDF 477 — the date, the method, and who you sent it to.' TIMING: 'Do it after you have served, not before.' The certificate is a component of the rendered packet and its fields are proven ink-free until service.

SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: stated in 'What this packet is not': not legal advice, not filed for you, and it does not decide eligibility — and the stop is drawn field by field: the section 7 affirmations must be read before swearing ('Read them before you swear to them'), the section 10 verification is signed only at the moment of declaring, the counsel signature block is left to an attorney, and sections 4-5 of the order belong to the court.
